name: @polymorpha/stella
description: Polymorpha Stella — Knowledge/Stella library (G25/G26 single retrieval plane). Wraps embeddings, vector store, knowledge, RAG pipelines. Depends on @polymorpha/business-logic, consumed by polymorpha UI via git+https. GitHub-only, no local fallback.

scripts.prepare: cd ts && npm install && npm run build
scripts.generate-types: python python/scripts/generate_types.py && cd ts && npx json2ts ../python/schema.json > src/shared/types/generated.ts
